spans.s:
दोषः [दुष् भावे करणे वा घञ्]
1 (a)
A fault, blame, censure, defect,
blemish, weak point; पत्रं नैव यदा
करीरविटपे दोषो वसंतस्य किं

; नात्र कुलपतिर्दोषं ग्रहीष्यति
Ś. 3 ‘will not find fault or take
exception’; so पुनरुक्तदोषा

. (b)
An error, a mistake.
--2 A crime, sin,
guilt, offence; जायामदोषामुत
संत्यजामि

.
--3 Noxious quality, badness,
injurious nature or quality; as in
आहारदोष.
--4 Harm, evil, danger,
injury; बहुदोषा हि शर्वरी

;
को दोषः ‘what harm is there’.
--5 Bad
or injurious consequence,
detrimental effect; तत्किमयमातपदोषः स्यात्
Ś. 3; अदाता वंशदोषेण
कर्मदोषाद्दरिद्रता

.
--6
Morbid affection, disease.
--7 Disorder
of the three humours of the body,
or the three humours when in a
disordered state.
--8 (In Nyāya &c.)
A fault of a definition; (i. e. अव्याप्ति,
अतिव्याप्ति and असंभव).
--9 (In Rhet.)
A fault or defect of composition
(such as पददोष, पदांशदोष, वाक्यदोष,
रसदोष, and अर्थदोष which are defined and
illustrated in the 7th Ullāsa of K. P.).
--10 A calf.
--11 Refutation.
--12
[]
Evening, dusk; cf. दोषा.
--Comp.
--आकर
a. faulty.
--आरोपः charge, accusation.
--एकदृश् a. fault-finding, censorious,
picking holes.
--कर, --कारिन्, --कृत्
a. causing evil, hurtful.
--ग्रस्त a.
{1} convicted, guilty. {2} full of
faults or defects.
--ग्राहिन् a. {1}
malicious, malignant. {2} censorious.
--ज्ञ a. knowing faults &c.
--(ज्ञः)
{1} a wise or learned man;

.
{2} a physician.
--त्रयं disorder or
vitiation of the three humours of the
body; (i. e. वात. पित्त and कफ).
--दृष्टि a. censorious.
--प्रसंगः
attaching blame, condemnation, censure.
--भाज् a. faulty, guilty, wrong.
--भेदः a peculiar modification of the
vitiation of the three humours.

दोषल a. Faulty, defective, corrupt,
sinful.

दोषिक a. (की f.) Faulty,
defective, bad.
--कः Sickness, disease.
दोष, दोषिक, दोषिन् See under दुष्.

दोषिन् a. (णी f.) [दुष्-णिनि]
1
Impure, corrupt, defiled,
contaminated.
--2 Faulty, defective.
--3
Criminal, wicked, sinful, guilty, bad.
दोष, दोषिक, दोषिन् See under दुष्.
दोष, दोषिक, दोषिन् See under दुष्.

दोषा ind. At night; दोषाऽपि
नूनमहिमांशुरसौ किलेति Śi. 4. 46; 62. --f.
1 The arm.
--2 The darkness of night,
night; घर्मकालदिवस इव क्षपितदोषः

(where the word means ‘a fault
or sin’ also).
--Comp.
--आस्यः, --तिलकः
a lamp.
--करः the moon.

दोषन् m., n. (This word has no
forms for the first five inflections,
i. e. before acc. pl.) An arm.

दोस् m. n. [दम्यते अनेन दम् दोऽसि
अर्द्धर्चा˚;

.
--2 The part
of an are defining its sine.
--3 The
side of a triangle or square.
--Comp.
--गडु (दोर्गड) a. crooked-armed,
--ग्रह (दोर्ग्रह) a. strong, powerful.
--(हः) pain in the arm.
--ज्या (
दोर्ज्या) the sine of the base.
--दंडः
(देर्दंडः) a stick-like arm, strong
arm;

.
--निकर्तनं (दोर्निकर्तमं) amputation of the
arm.
--मूलं (दोंर्भूलं) the arm-pit.
[]
--युद्धं (दोर्युद्धं) a duel;

.
--शिखरं (दोः शिंखरं) the shoulder.
--सहस्रभृत् (दोः सहस्रभृत्) m. {1} an
epithet of the demon Bāṇa. {2} an
epithet of Sahasrārjuna.
--स्थः (दोस्थः)
{1} a servant. {2} service. {3} a
player. {4} play, sport.
